items.headline: Falcon 9 ushered in the modern space economy – retiring it could leave the industry vulnerable
items.summary: SpaceX’s Falcon 9 rocket has allowed NASA, private companies, universities and nonprofits alike to launch satellites, spacecraft and even astronauts to orbit.

items.label: SpaceX
items.headline: US Air Force Sends Military Supplies Into Space and Back on SpaceX Capsule in Test of Rocket Cargo Delivery
items.summary: The US Air Force used a SpaceX re-entry capsule to test carrying military supplies through space, assessing whether rocket cargo could eventually reach remote locations faster than aircraft.
